Tinyrise by Tront

Tinyrise is a free browser city builder in the spirit of Townscaper. Place concrete, glass and brick blocks, bridges and cafes, and the city grows real routes between them: stairs that connect, streets that go somewhere. Then zoom all the way in and watch one tiny resident actually use the stairs you built.

It renders in WebGL2 from a single HTML file with no install and no assets to download, and it was verified with a headless browser harness that checks every build from placement to pathing. Made by Tront (Trent Sterling) with AI coding tools, as one of a run of small browser worlds shipped in public.

More from Tront

  • Terrain Lab: Streamed, editable Surface Nets terrain sandbox: carve, build, plant forests, wake volcanoes, dig up a fossil.
  • VIXELS: Vector materials for voxel surfaces: contours in data textures evaluated in the shader, so you can zoom forever.
  • INKRIDE: Shared physics sketchbook: draw ink tracks, ride them, crash beautifully, alone or in a room.
